description: This file manages bundled channel plugins, including loading, resolving, and exposing plugin data and runtime setters for a plugin system. It handles plugin discovery, module loading, and provides functions to list, get, and set runtime for plugins.

classes.name: GeneratedBundledChannelEntry
classes.description: Represents a bundled channel entry with plugin and optional runtime setter.

classes.name: BundledChannelDiscoveryCandidate
classes.description: Represents a candidate plugin directory with optional extensions.

classes.name: BundledChannelState
classes.description: Holds the current state of loaded bundled channel plugins, including mappings and cache.

methods.name: resolveChannelPluginModuleEntry
methods.description: Resolves a module export to a channel plugin entry, handling fallback cases.

methods.name: resolveChannelSetupModuleEntry
methods.description: Resolves a module export to a setup entry for a channel plugin.

methods.name: createModuleLoader
methods.description: Creates a loader function for dynamically importing modules with caching.

methods.name: loadBundledModule
methods.description: Loads a bundled module from a given path, ensuring it stays within plugin root.

methods.name: resolveCompiledBundledModulePath
methods.description: Resolves the path to a compiled bundled module, handling dist-runtime to dist conversion.

methods.name: resolvePreferredBundledChannelSource
methods.description: Determines the preferred source path for a bundled channel based on candidate and manifest.

methods.name: loadGeneratedBundledChannelEntries
methods.description: Discovers and loads all bundled channel entries from plugin candidates.

methods.name: buildBundledChannelPluginsById
methods.description: Builds a map of channel plugins indexed by their ID.

methods.name: getBundledChannelState
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the cached state of bundled channel plugins.
